db:select.doc:name: Select User
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id, name, email, date_of_birth, biological_sex, height_cm, weight_kg, activity_baseline, daily_caloric_target, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = :userId AND deleted_at IS NULL

db:select.doc:name: Select User Goal
db:select.db:sql: SELECT goal_id, user_id, goal_type, goal_direction, target_value, target_unit, is_primary, is_active, set_at, achieved_at FROM user_goals WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select Conditions
db:select.db:sql: SELECT condition_id, user_id, condition_type, management_status, diagnosed_at, notes, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM user_conditions WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select Dietary Constraints
db:select.db:sql: SELECT constraint_id, user_id, constraint_type, constraint_value, severity, is_active, created_at FROM dietary_constraints WHERE user_id = :userId

db:select.doc:name: Select User Preference
db:select.db:sql: SELECT preference_id, user_id, insight_frequency, preferred_wearable_metrics, preferred_nutrition_metrics, typical_breakfast_time, typical_lunch_time, typical_dinner_time, typical_sleep_time, target_sleep_duration_hrs, units_system, created_at, updated_at FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id = :userId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { userId: vars.user[0].user_id, name: vars.user[0].name, email: vars.user[0].email, dateOfBirth: vars.user[0].date_of_birth, biologicalSex: vars.user[0].biological_sex, heightCm: vars.user[0].height_cm, weightKg: vars.user[0].weight_kg, activityBaseline: vars.user[0].activity_baseline, dailyCaloricTarget: vars.user[0].daily_caloric_target, createdAt: vars.user[0].created_at, updatedAt: vars.user[0].updated_at, goals: vars.user_goal map (goal)->{ goalId: goal.goalId, userId: goal.user_id, goalType: goal.goal_type, goalDirection: goal.goal_direction, targetValue: goal.target_value, targetUnit: goal.target_unit, isPrimary: goal.is_primary, isActive: goal.is_active, setAt: goal.set_at, achievedAt: goal.achieved_at }, conditions: vars.user_conditions map (condition) ->{ conditionId: condition.condition_id, userId: condition.user_id, conditionType: condition.condition_type, diagnosedAt: condition.diagnosed_at, notes: condition.notes, managementStatus: condition.management_status, isActive: condition.is_active, createdAt: condition.created_at }, constraints: vars.dietary_constraints map (row)->{ constraintId: row.constraint_id, userId: row.user_id, constraintType: row.constraint_type, constraintValue: row.constraint_value, severity: row.severity, isActive: row.is_active, createdAt: row.created_at }, preferences: if(sizeOf(vars.user_preference) > 0) { preferenceId: vars.user_preference.preference_id, userId: vars.user_preference.user_id, insightFrequency: vars.user_preference.insight_frequency, preferredWearableMetrics: vars.user_preference.preferred_wearable_metrics, preferredNutritionMetrics: vars.user_preference.preferred_nutrition_metrics, typicalBreakfastTime: vars.user_preference.typical_breakfast_time, typicalLunchTime: vars.user_preference.typical_lunch_time, typicalDinnerTime: vars.user_preference.typical_dinner_time, typicalSleepTime: vars.user_preference.typical_sleep_time, targetSleepDurationHrs: vars.user_preference.target_sleep_duration_hrs, unitsSystem: vars.user_preference.units_system, createdAt: vars.user_preference.created_at, updatedAt: vars.user_preference.updated_at }else null }

db:select.doc:name: Select User Id
db:select.db:sql: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE (user_id = :userId OR email = :email) AND deleted_at IS NULL
